	keybindKb    = "F",

	locked       = false,
	posX         = nil,

}

local cfg = {}
for k, v in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do cfg[k] = v end

local function resolveKb(name)
	if not name or name == "" or name == "None" then return nil end
	local ok, val = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
	return (ok and val) or nil
end

local function saveConfig()
	if not writefile then return end
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg) end)
	if ok and encoded then pcall(writefile, CONFIG_FILE, encoded) end
end

local function loadConfig()
	pcall(function()
		if not (type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function") then return end
		if not isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then return end
		local raw = readfile(CONFIG_FILE)
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
		cfg.keybindKb    = type(data.keybindKb) == "string" and data.keybindKb or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindKb
		cfg.keybindGp    = type(data.keybindGp) == "string" and data.keybindGp or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindGp
		if type(data.autoBrainrot) == "boolean" then cfg.autoBrainrot = data.autoBrainrot end
		local sc = tonumber(data.uiScale)
		if sc then cfg.uiScale = math.clamp(sc, 0.5, 1.8) end
		cfg.locked = data.locked == true
		cfg.posX = tonumber(data.posX)
		cfg.posY = tonumber(data.posY)
	end)
end
pcall(loadConfig)

local function tw(obj, props, t, style)
	TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.22, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function corner(p, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner", p)
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 16)
	return c
end

local function stroke(p, col, th, tr)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", p)
	s.Color = col or C.soft
	s.Thickness = th or 1.4
	s.Transparency = tr or 0.35
	return s
end

local function grad(p, c1, c2, rot)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", p)
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2)
	})
	g.Rotation = rot or 125
	return g
end

-- Shine helper (fast + visible)
local function shineStroke(strokeObj, baseCol)
	task.spawn(function()
		while strokeObj and strokeObj.Parent do
			TweenService:Create(strokeObj, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				Transparency = 0.05
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.28)
			TweenService:Create(strokeObj, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
				Color = baseCol or C.soft,
				Transparency = 0.35
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.55)
		end
	end)
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
	handle = handle or frame
	local dragging, start, pos
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if cfg.locked then return end
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			start = i.Position
			pos = frame.Position
			i.Changed:Connect(function()
				if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
					cfg.posX = frame.Position.X.Offset
					cfg.posY = frame.Position.Y.Offset
					saveConfig()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = i.Position - start
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset + d.X, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
end

local function bindTap(btn, fn)
	btn.Active = true
	btn.Selectable = true
	local last = 0
	local function fire()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - last < 0.2 then return end
		last = now
		fn()
	end
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fire)
	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then fire() end
	end)
end

local function isGamepad(kc)
	local n = kc.Name
	return n:sub(1,6)=="Button" or n:sub(1,10)=="Thumbstick" or n:sub(1,4)=="DPad" or n=="ButtonSelect" or n=="ButtonStart"
end

local function decodeBase64(data)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lookup = {}
    for i = 1, #alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
    data = data:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", "")
    local out, buffer, bits = {}, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #data do
        local ch = data:sub(i, i)
        if ch == "=" then break end
        local value = lookup[ch]
        if value then
            buffer = buffer * 64 + value
            bits = bits + 6
            if bits >= 8 then
                bits = bits - 8
                local byte = math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits)) % 256
                out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
                buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

        end

        if type(asset) == "string" then FLOWER_IMAGE_ID = asset end
    end)
end

local function commitPower()
    local n = tonumber(powerVal.Text)
    if n then
        powerSetting = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, 1000000)
    end
    powerVal.Text = tostring(powerSetting)
end

local function commitDelay()
    local n = tonumber(delayVal.Text)
    if n then
        delaySetting = math.clamp(n, 0.01, 5)
    end
    delayVal.Text = string.format("%.3f", delaySetting)
end

powerVal.FocusLost:Connect(commitPower)
delayVal.FocusLost:Connect(commitDelay)

-- ===================== LOGIC =====================
local function findRemote()
	local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
	if not rrs then return nil end
	local names = {"SetPlayerBlockList", "UpdatePlayerBlockList", "SetBlockList", "UpdateBlockList"}
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
		if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return r end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then return c end
	end
	return nil
end
remote = findRemote()

-- Intentionally local-only demo: no remote payloads or server requests are sent.

local function setUIActive(on)
	if on then
		activateLbl.Text = "ACTIVE"
		actGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 68)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)),
		})
		actStroke.Color = C.white
		actStroke.Transparency = 0.1
		statusLbl.Text = "ACTIVE"
		statusLbl.TextColor3 = C.white
		tw(statusPill, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 55, 40)}, 0.22)
		tw(activateBtn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}, 0.22)
	else
		activateLbl.Text = "INACTIVE"
		actGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 32)),
		})
		actStroke.Color = C.soft
		actStroke.Transparency = 0.3
		statusLbl.Text = "INACTIVE"
		statusLbl.TextColor3 = C.dim
		tw(statusPill, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36)}, 0.22)
		tw(activateBtn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, 0.22)
	end
end

local function runPingLoop()
    -- Local-only preview. Power and delay fields are editable UI settings only.
end

local function flipLag(state)
	active = state
	if active then
		setUIActive(true)
		task.spawn(runPingLoop)
	else
		setUIActive(false)
	end
end

bindTap(activateBtn, function()
	flipLag(not active)
end)

local function openSettings()
	settingsOpen = true
	settings.Visible = true
	settings.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SET_W, 0)
	tw(settings, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SET_W, SET_H)}, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	brBtn.Text = cfg.autoBrainrot and "ON" or "OFF"
	brBtn.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.autoBrainrot and C.green or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 52)
	lockBtn.Text = cfg.locked and "ON" or "OFF"
	lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.locked and C.green or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 52)
	kbBind.Text = cfg.keybindKb
	gpBind.Text = cfg.keybindGp
end

local function closeSettings()
	settingsOpen = false
	listeningFor = nil
	tw(settings, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SET_W, 0)}, 0.18)
	task.delay(0.19, function() settings.Visible = false end)
end

bindTap(settingsBtn, function()
	if settingsOpen then closeSettings() else openSettings() end
end)
bindTap(setClose, closeSettings)

bindTap(brBtn, function()
	cfg.autoBrainrot = not cfg.autoBrainrot
	brBtn.Text = cfg.autoBrainrot and "ON" or "OFF"
	tw(brBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = cfg.autoBrainrot and C.green or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 52)}, 0.18)
	saveConfig()
end)

bindTap(lockBtn, function()
	cfg.locked = not cfg.locked
	lockBtn.Text = cfg.locked and "ON" or "OFF"
	tw(lockBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = cfg.locked and C.green or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 52)}, 0.18)
	saveConfig()
end)

local function updateBindLabels()
	if listeningFor == "kb" then
		kbBind.Text = "..."
		kbBind.TextColor3 = C.waiting
	else
		kbBind.Text = cfg.keybindKb
		kbBind.TextColor3 = C.white
	end
	if listeningFor == "gp" then
		gpBind.Text = "..."
		gpBind.TextColor3 = C.waiting
	else
		gpBind.Text = cfg.keybindGp
		gpBind.TextColor3 = C.white
	end
end

kbBind.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	listeningFor = (listeningFor == "kb") and nil or "kb"
	updateBindLabels()
end)
gpBind.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	listeningFor = (listeningFor == "gp") and nil or "gp"
	updateBindLabels()
end)
kbClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	cfg.keybindKb = "None"
	listeningFor = nil
	updateBindLabels()
	saveConfig()
end)
gpClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	cfg.keybindGp = "None"
	listeningFor = nil
	updateBindLabels()
	saveConfig()
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not cfg.autoBrainrot then
		if brainrotMode then
			brainrotMode = false
			lastBrainrotState = false
		end
		return
	end
	local char = plr.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	local hasBrainrot = hum.WalkSpeed < 25
	if hasBrainrot and not lastBrainrotState then
		brainrotMode = true
		lastBrainrotState = true
		flipLag(true)
	elseif not hasBrainrot and lastBrainrotState then
		brainrotMode = false
		lastBrainrotState = false
		flipLag(false)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	local kc = input.KeyCode
	if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
	local isGp = isGamepad(kc)
	local isKb = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard

	if listeningFor then
		if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			listeningFor = nil
			updateBindLabels()
			return
		end
		if listeningFor == "kb" and isKb and not BLACKLISTED[kc] then
			cfg.keybindKb = kc.Name
			listeningFor = nil
			updateBindLabels()
			saveConfig()
			return
		end
		if listeningFor == "gp" and isGp then
			cfg.keybindGp = kc.Name
			listeningFor = nil
			updateBindLabels()
			saveConfig()
			return
		end
		return
	end

	if processed then return end

	if kc == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
		main.Visible = not main.Visible
		if not main.Visible then closeSettings() end
		return
	end

	local kbEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindKb)
	local gpEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindGp)
	if (kbEnum and kc == kbEnum and isKb) or (gpEnum and kc == gpEnum and isGp) then
		flipLag(not active)
	end
end)
